Mega Man X5 Widescreen

This default-disabled mod enables Mega Man X5's game-specific 16:9 field of
view through the stable mmx5.widescreen activation plugin.

The full-2D gameplay classification, widened background tile loop, HUD bounds,
and object/primitive activation and cull hooks remain identity transforms at
native 4:3. Enabling this mod activates the reviewed 16:9 path.

Widescreen is experimental. Mega Man X5's engine renders a true 4:3 view, so
the additional field of view is reconstructed rather than merely unstretched.

Credit

mstan - widescreen implementation and mod integration
